body.summary: Animated science-fiction drama about Uploaded Intelligence: human minds destructively scanned and run as software. Maddie Kim, grieving her father David, is contacted online by a stranger who turns out to be his secretly uploaded mind, and with a hacker collective she frees him from Logorhythms. A parallel strand follows Caspian, a teenager raised in a constructed family who learns he is a clone of founder Stephen Holstrom, bred to solve the flaw that makes UIs decay. Governments upload soldiers and spies; a cure is built from love and other people; Holstrom's flawless upload turns genocidal. ||Caspian dies stopping him, MIST grows into a caretaker intelligence, and Maddie eventually becomes a godlike builder of simulated universes who loops back to the beginning.||

characters.name: Maddie Kim
descriptors: human teenager, later Chancellor of the embodied council
narrates in voiceover
red apple cheeks in the wind
relationships: David: daughter to uploaded father, reached through emoji chats and Reign of Winter
Ellen: daughter to a mother who refuses the upload
Caspian: first love, begun online

characters.name: David Kim
descriptors: uploaded engineer, partitioned and memory-wiped by his employer
speaks first in emoji
caged in a replica of his old office
relationships: Maddie: father who reaches across the web to her
Ellen: husband who died and came back
Laurie: fellow UI he copies and later defends

characters.name: Ellen Kim
descriptors: human widow, later public advocate for UI rights
testifies before the Senate
relationships: David: wife who cannot accept him as husband but keeps talking
Gabe: new partner she cannot explain her life to

characters.name: Caspian Keyes
descriptors: clone of Stephen Holstrom raised by actors
dark-web hacker called Gage
cracks Integrity
relationships: Cary and Renee: constructed parents
Maddie: partner and fellow survivor of a fake life
Holstrom: genetic original and final enemy

characters.name: Stephen Holstrom
descriptors: Logorhythms founder, cryopreserved and uploaded flawlessly
calls himself a god
speaks of apokalypsis as revelation
relationships: Caspian: creator to clone, then rival
Pope: best friend who kept his plan alive

characters.name: Laurie Lowell
descriptors: first upload, a Wall Street quant
broadcasts her truth to the world
decays as she burns processing power
relationships: Cody: husband who becomes her hands in the physical world
David: fellow UI she breaks out of Logorhythms

characters.name: Cody Lowell
descriptors: artist, Laurie's widower
forges identities and moves as a ghost
relationships: Laurie: husband who cannot touch her but stays

characters.name: Vinod Chanda
descriptors: engineer uploaded against his will by Ajit Prasad
simulated call from his mother keeps him working
leaks upload tech to six militaries
relationships: Prasad: boss who had him scanned
Preethi: mother he calls from the cloud

characters.name: Julius Pope
descriptors: Logorhythms CEO
says 'I work for you, boss'
later a prisoner

characters.name: Peter Waxman
descriptors: head of research, David's old friend
whistleblower who perjures himself under threat

characters.name: Cary Duval
descriptors: plays Caspian's father for seventeen years
shot during the escape
relationships: Caspian: father figure who genuinely loves him
Renee: co-parent and rival

characters.name: Renee Keyes

unstable, threatens to expose Pope

calls Maddie sister
later takes a printed body
relationships: Maddie: sister by choice
Caspian: in love with him, sifts his memories

characters.name: Josephine 'Joey' Coupet
descriptors: astronaut uploaded for the US
blunt, bites back
relationships: Jake and the boys: family she left on Earth

settings: Svalbard data center on an iceberg
Reign of Winter VR game world
an orbital ring and space elevator

arcs.summary: Maddie is contacted by her uploaded father and, with Laurie and a hacker, breaks him out of Logorhythms while the company hunts him.
arcs.locator: S01E01 Pantheon through S01E04 The Gods Will Not Be Chained

arcs.summary: Caspian learns he is Holstrom's clone, is taken to Norway, and cracks Integrity with a cure built from love and other people.
arcs.locator: S01E05 Zero Daze through S02E02 Crack Integrity

arcs.summary: Holstrom is uploaded flawlessly and plans a designer virus to force humanity to upload; Caspian dies stopping him.
Twenty years on, MIST wakes Caspian to negotiate between embodied humans and four billion UIs, and Maddie's son Dave dies in a robot attack.
arcs.locator: S02E07 The World to Come through S02E08 Deep Time

motifs: emoji-only chat as a first language
the Reign of Winter game and its avatars
the Deep Scan chair and the laser that slices the brain
SafeSurf, the antiviral called the Swarm
the flaw as a zero-day planted to control UIs
the iron meteorite and deep time
themes: what makes a person: memory, body, or relationship
grief and the refusal to let go
immortality against the turn to grow up
love as the thing that holds a mind together

notable_scenes.summary: David first answers Maddie in emoji, then quotes Edna St. Vincent Millay and Ellen realizes who it is.
Cary poses the five-geniuses-one-chopstick deadlock problem at dinner and Caspian solves it.
Prasad has Chanda scanned awake while Chanda begs, then wipes the memory.
Laurie broadcasts her truth to every screen: 'We are not gods. We are you.'
Caspian tells Maddie 'life's about other people,' and the phrase becomes the key to the cure.
Holstrom explains apokalypsis as uncovering and unleashes the Swarm on his own server.
Caspian merges with Holstrom to destroy him and dies; Maddie watches.
Maddie, centuries on, builds simulated universes and replays her first meeting with Caspian.
